en.headline: Water pipe leak closes Sha Tin road near City One Station
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is carrying out emergency repairs on Chap Wai Kon Street, with all lanes towards Shek Mun closed since Friday morning and 21 bus routes diverted.
body: A water pipe leak near City One Station in Sha Tin forced the full closure of Chap Wai Kon Street heading towards Shek Mun on Friday morning, disrupting local traffic and requiring diversions for more than 20 bus routes.

The Water Supplies Department dispatched emergency teams to the site between Ngan Shing Street and Ngau Pei Sha Street after the leak was reported. Authorities closed all lanes of the affected stretch to allow excavation and pipeline repairs while ensuring public safety.

As of mid-afternoon, 21 franchised bus services heading towards Shek Mun had been diverted, including 17 Kowloon Motor Bus routes, two Long Win airport services and two cross-harbour routes. Motorists were advised to use alternative roads such as Tai Chung Kiu Road and to follow on-site police directions.
RTHK traffic updates continued to list the full closure and bus diversions into the evening. The department has not yet announced a completion time for the repairs.

zh.headline: 沙田插桅杆街近第一城站水管急修封路
zh.dek: 水務署正於插桅杆街往石門方向進行緊急維修，該段全線自周五早上封閉，至少21條巴士路線須改道。
body: 沙田第一城站附近一條水管出現滲漏，周五早上導致插桅杆街往石門方向介乎銀城街至牛皮沙街之間全線封閉，區內交通受阻，多條巴士路線需改道。
水務署緊急人員接報後到場隔離受損路段並展開挖掘工程。當局為方便維修及確保安全，封閉相關路段所有行車線。
截至下午，往石門方向有21條專營巴士路線改道，包括17條九巴路線、兩條龍運機場路線及兩條過海路線。駕駛人士被建議改用大涌橋路等替代道路，並遵從現場警員指示。
港台交通消息至傍晚仍列出有關封路及巴士改道安排。水務署尚未公布維修完成時間。
